decision.explanation: Document d1 asserts Henry Gilbert was a citizen of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland based on his 1913 birth in England during that state's existence, while document d2 claims he held dual citizenship including Iran based on maternal lineage and documents obtained in the 1950s; these represent incompatible claims about the same referent's citizenship status found in the provided text.
